newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EDS raised to accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EDS raised to accumulate.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its near-term recommendation on EDS Corp to accumulate from neutral.
-- Left unchanged the long-term buy rating.
-- Shares were trading up 2-1/2 at 43-5/8 in midmorning exchange trade.
-- Analyst Stephen McClellan said in a research note that the "stock decline (is) overdone."

-- "Since last Wednesday's earnings announcement and management forewarning regarding the EPS growth slowdown over the next two quarters, EDS shares have plummeted 31 percent and now appear to represent a value," the analyst said.

-- "At this level or at any lower price, we view the stock as a good value. Our price objective is a price/earnings (multiple) of at least 20 times our 1998 estimate of around $2.65 to $2.70 (per share), or at least $54 (per share) 12 to 18 month from now," the anaylst added.
-- The 1997 earnings estimate is $2.35 per share, and McClellan said the forecasts for both years may be conservative.

-- "Under a worst case scenario, we believe earnings will expand at a double digit pace in the future. However, revenues may slow if the company does not win big outsourcing deals and, regardless, its margins may moderate. And the near-term outlook calls for moderate earnings gain, not flat or declining or EPS," he said.
